flacmn.summary: Finds digital copies of albums on the Internet Archive, ranks their quality, and files them into your music library. something something cd art

search.title: Search archive.org
search.caption: Every format is ranked together, best quality first. Here a CD rip of Kind of Blue tops the list.

listen.title: Check the spectrogram
listen.caption: Pick a track and its spectrogram draws on its own. The tags on the right are checked against MusicBrainz.

save.title: Add it to your library
save.caption: Downloads queue up and are checked against archive.org's checksums before they are filed.

scans.title: Find the CD case scans
scans.caption: Scans come from the album folder, archive.org and the Cover Art Archive, including other pressings of the same CD.

fill.title: Fill in what's missing
fill.caption: No back or inside scan? Those parts take colours from the cover, with the tracklist printed on them.

print.title: Print the case
print.caption: One PDF, true size: front insert, tray card with spines, the inside, and the disc label.

pivmn.summary: A desktop app for particle image velocimetry: it turns DaVis projects or image pairs into velocity fields, planar or stereo, on a CPU or a GPU.

source.title: Choose the input
source.caption: A DaVis .set project, a folder of .set files to run as a batch, or a folder of image pairs in .im7, TIFF or PNG.

mode.title: Pick planar or stereo, CPU or GPU
mode.caption: Both modes run on either backend. The CPU backend works on any computer; the GPU one needs an NVIDIA card with CUDA.

setup.title: Set units, output and calibration
setup.caption: Calibration is read straight from the project's own Calibration.xml, and stereo viewing angles are worked out at every correlation point.

tune.title: Tune the passes and filters
tune.caption: Set the multi-pass window schedule, then the filters that reject spurious vectors and fill and smooth the field.

preview.title: Preview the first pair
preview.caption: Check the result on one pair before committing to the whole batch.

run.title: Run the batch
run.caption: The batch runs in the background, and the results can be plotted as vector fields.

phdmn.summary: PhD research in experimental fluid mechanics: turbulence from a random jet array, porous disk settling, and machine-learning control of the tank.
